title: Batch Import Transaction & Recovery
objective: Implement stage → inspect → user accept/reject → commit semantics with cancellation, resumable cursors, partial-failure isolation and idempotent retry.

matching_red.reason: Focused ARI-10 regression/profile existed while the production batch-import transaction/recovery module was intentionally absent; exact-head Linux client typecheck failed with TS2307 for batch-import-transaction-recovery.

completion_summary: Implemented a storage-neutral immutable batch-import transaction state contract covering stage, inspect, explicit accept/reject, commit, safe cancellation, deterministic resumable cursors, per-resource partial-failure isolation and idempotent retry. Only explicitly accepted candidates can commit; rejected candidates remain uncommitted, retries skip already committed effects, source inputs remain unmutated, and no rights/license, provider, distribution or release authority is inferred or activated.
